title: Rewinding the Input Buffer
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y,x,u$ be binary words, let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ positions, and let $j\le |x|$. Starting in loader state $4$ with input-buffer head at $j-1$ and choice-buffer head at $|u|$, after exactly $j+1$ steps the pair-loader machine is in loader state $5$, with the same physical input position and tape contents, input-buffer head at $0$, and choice-buffer head at $|u|-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic machine over the binary alphabet
$p$ is a valid input-head position for $y$
replaced: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine, let $x$ and $u$ be buffer words, and let $j \le |x|$. From the loader configuration in the input-rewind state with input-buffer head at position $j-1$ and choice head at the right end of $u$, exactly $j+1$ steps of the pair-loader machine reach the choice-rewind state with input-buffer head reset to zero and choice head at position $|u| - 1$, with all tape contents preserved.
